**Wrote the 4.2.0 section** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 14 user-facing.

Three breaking changes hide under `refactor:` prefixes. The v1 export route is gone. The internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`. Only one real feature: webhook retries with backoff.

Two things to check before you cut. I dated it `2026-08-29`. And several `docs:` commits note a minimum Node version, but no `engines` bump appears in the log.
